subject: general
question: The National Development Council was established in accordance with:
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Planning Commission's suggestions**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Development Council (NDC) was established in **1952**.
 
• Its creation was based on the recommendations and suggestions of the Planning Commission of India.
 
• The NDC aims to **strengthen and mobilize the effort and resources of the nation in support of the Plan**.
 
• It provides a platform for discussing issues related to social and economic development and ensures the balanced and rapid economic growth of India.
 
• The NDC includes the Prime Minister, Union Cabinet Ministers, Chief Ministers of all states, and members of the Planning Commission.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Planning Commission of India**

 
 
• Established in 1950 by a resolution of the Government of India.
 
• It was tasked with formulating India's Five-Year Plans and assessing the country's resources.
 
• In 2015, it was replaced by the NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India).
 
 
 
• **Five-Year Plans**
 
 
• These are centralized and integrated national economic programs.
 
• The first Five-Year Plan was launched in 1951, focusing on the agricultural sector.
 
• The plans are aimed at improving the standard of living and achieving economic growth.
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog**
 
 
• Replaced the Planning Commission in 2015.
 
• It serves as the premier policy think tank of the Government of India.
 
• Aims to foster cooperative federalism through structured support initiatives and mechanisms.
 
 
 
• **National Development Council (NDC)**
 
 
• It is not a statutory body but functions as an advisory body.
 
• Its purpose is to strengthen and mobilize the effort and resources of the nation in support of the Plan.
 
• It includes representatives from both the central and state governments.
